# glinet_wireguard_client_group (Resource)

Manages a group of WireGuard client configurations (`wg-client.add_group` in the router API). The resource manages only groups of the user (Manual in the web UI), not the presets of VPN service providers. Add configurations to the group with `glinet_wireguard_client_config`. Destroy removes the group from the router. Destroy fails while the group has configurations, also configurations that Terraform does not manage, because the router API removes a group with its configurations, and the web UI does not offer to remove the group of the running tunnel. What the router does when it gets the removal of the group of the running tunnel is not known. Import the group with its ID, for example `terraform import glinet_wireguard_client_group.example 1234`. The write of this resource was not tested on a router; the parameters come from the router's web UI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glinet_wireguard_client_group" "home" {
  name = "home"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the group (`group_name` in the router API): 1 to 64 characters, not only spaces, without a `.` at the start and without `~`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) ID of the group, which the router gives (`group_id` in the router API).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the group ID.
terraform import glinet_wireguard_client_group.home 1234
```
